question: P spends 36% of his income on food items and 25% of the remaining amount on clothes, medical and conveyance. He saves half of the remaining amount every month. If he saves ₹1,80,000 every year, then find his monthly income.
solution:
Given:

P spends 36% of his income on food items and 25% of the remaining amount on clothes, medical and conveyance.

He saves a sum of ₹1,80,000 every year.

He saves half of the remaining amount every month.

Calculation:

Let P's total income be 100a

P's expenditure on food = 36a

Remaining = 64a

His total spend on clothes, medical and conveyance = 64a × 25% = 16a

Remaining = 48a

Savings = 1/2 × 48a = 24a

Now,

His annual saving = 180000

So,

His monthly saving = 180000/12 = 15000

24a → 15000

⇒ 100a = 15000/24a × 100 = 62500

∴ His income is Rs. 62500.
